newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns AA- rating to Ajinomoto's notes.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AA- rating to Ajinomoto's notes.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Tuesday that it had assigned its AA- long-term rating to Ajinomoto Co Inc's 50 billion yen worth of senior unsecured notes.
The rating reflects Ajinomoto's improved financial profile and well-established market position, the credit rating firm said in a report.
The funds raised from the issue, with maturities ranging from four to ten years, will be used to redeem maturing convertible bonds, the report said.
The rating outlook is stable, it said.
